Wheel configuration comparison

Each row is one commanded direction; each panel is one wheel configuration, all drawn to the same scale (±1.3 m). Faint lines are individual trials, the bold line is their mean and the dashed line is the expected 1 m path. Every run starts at the black dot facing up. Panel titles give the mean final position error ± σ across trials. Hover a line to see which trial it is.

Jump to: 0° · 45° · 90° · 135° · 180° · 225° · 270° · 315°

Plots use the robot's starting frame: the start position is the origin and the starting heading points up (0°), so the expected path runs at the commanded angle. Heading is the change from the starting heading.
